hypothesis: A bagged smooth additive model learns local nonparametric effects; eight automatically selected pair functions test low-dimensional nonlinear interactions without a deep tree or MLP.
new_vs_failed: No EBM was used in prior rounds. This is a cyclic additive/pairwise functional model, not another CatBoost/HGB parameter or mixture search. The exact 63-column input matches prior compact CatBoost for a cached secondary control.
features: Same pre-existing CORE55 plus eight original nominal categorical fields; no feature or proxy experiment and no ID predictor
validation: All model fitting, pair selection and internal early stopping stay within allowed training rows. Reuse cached reference and CatBoost holdout predictions; no refitting old failed methods.
screening: Require dev delta > .002 vs cached fixed reference; stop without outer validation if absent
history: Historically reused development data is exploratory; no new Kaggle score.
